name: Componency Pattern
description: To represent (non-transitively) that entities either are proper parts of other entities, or have proper parts.
scenarios: This Content OP allows designers to represent part-whole relations. It allows to distinguish between parts and proper parts. Relation of proper part is not transitive, and implies a simple  part of relation, which is transitive. Temporal indexing is not expressible. To solve this issue see the  time indexed part of Content OP.
competency_questions: What is this entity component of? What are the components of this entity?
